chatBridge.help:
**Kite from your chat app**
`/list` sessions that need you, and recent ones
`/s 3` choose session 3; then just write to it (queued while it works)
`/now text` into the running turn now
`/new` a new session (`/new 2 1`: project 2, agent 1); your next message starts it
`/stop` stop the running turn
`/y` allow · `/n` deny · `/2` choose option 2 (`/2 a note` adds a note)
`/get 1` the last turn's first artifact, as a file
Send pictures and files as they are; start with two slashes, as `//compact`, to send a command to the agent as written.
